Business rules:
- RULE-001 [P0] Account type must be CTE, AHO or VIR: A payment order is only accepted for account types CTE, AHO or VIR. Any other account type is rejected with error 50001 and the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:34-37)
- RULE-002 [P0] Payment order must be pending to be paid: An order can only proceed when its status is 'P' (pending). Any other status is rejected with error 50003 and the message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:42-45, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:54-54, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:56-57)
- RULE-003 [P0] Payment rejected when order does not exist: If the lookup of the order to be paid returns no rows, the payment is rejected with error code 50002 and the message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:47-50)
- RULE-004 [P0] Commission tariff lookup: company-specific tariff overrides service default: The base tariff for a payment is the one agreed for the company and service. If the company has no specific tariff for that service, the service's default tariff is used and the commission is not charged separately ('N'). If no tariff can be determined, it is zero. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:62-66, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:68-68, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:70-72, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:76-77)
- RULE-005 [P0] Comisión por canal y servicio NOMINA: The commission is half the tariff, rounded to 2 decimals, when the payment comes through the WEB channel. Any other channel pays the full tariff. Service 'NOMINA' never carries a commission. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:80-81, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:83-83, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:85-86)
- RULE-006 [P0] Total a debitar según comisión separada: If the commission is flagged as separate ('S'), only the order amount is debited. Otherwise the commission is added to the order amount and debited together with it. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:89-90, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:92-92)
- RULE-007 [P0] Sufficient funds check with overdraft margin for non-VIR accounts: The payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' when the account balance does not cover the total. VIR accounts must cover the total exactly. All other account types may go up to 100.00 below the total, so the check is balance + 100.00 against the total. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:95-98, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:100-101, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:103-104)
- RULE-008 [P0] Débito de la cuenta por el pago de la orden: The order payment is charged to the customer's account for the computed total, with reference 'PAGO ORDEN'. If the debit fails, the payment ends with error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:110-115, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:117-117, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:120-121)
- RULE-009 [P0] Separately charged commission is debited from the account: If the commission is to be charged separately ('S') and is greater than zero, it is debited from the payer's account with the reference 'COMISION PAGO'. If the debit fails, the operation ends with error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:126-126, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:128-132, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:134-134, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:137-138)
- RULE-010 [P0] Failed commission undoes the payment: If the commission step returns a non-zero code (@w_return <> 0), the procedure issues a rollback of the current transaction and sets @w_error = 50006 and @o_mensaje = 'ERROR EN COMISION'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:134-138)
- RULE-011 [P0] Order marked as paid with payment date and commission: When an order is paid, its state becomes 'A', the payment date is set to the process date and the calculated commission is stored on the order of that company. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:144-149)
- RULE-012 [P0] Order must be updated for the payment to stand: If updating the order fails or affects no rows, the payment is rolled back and error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN' is returned. A payment is never kept when the order is not marked as updated. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:153-156)
- RULE-013 [P0] Successful payment is committed atomically: When the debit, commission and order update all succeed, the transaction is committed and the result message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:161-163)

Graph nodes (id, kind, lines):
- proc:dbo.sp_pago_orden (StoredProcedure, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp, lines 6-171)
  Pays a pending payment order by debiting a customer account. It validates the account type, checks the order is pending, works out the tariff and commission, and checks funds. It then debits the account (and the commission separately when required) and marks the order as paid in the orders table. On success it returns 'PAGO REALIZADO' and the movement number; any failure rolls back and goes to the error handler, which calls sp_cerror.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B1 (block 'RF-01: only current, savings and virtual accounts can be debited', lines 20-39, phase pre)
    Checks that the account type is current, savings or virtual. If not, it sets error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' and jumps to the error block. Otherwise processing continues to the order check.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B2 (block 'RF-02: the order must exist and be pending', lines 41-59, phase pre)
    Reads the order's status from the payment orders table for the given order number and company. If the order does not exist (50002) or is not pending (50003), it sets the error message and jumps to the error block. Otherwise it continues to the tariff lookup.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B3 (block 'RF-03: the tariff comes from the company table, else from the general service ta', lines 61-77, phase pre)
    Finds the tariff for the service, first in the company-specific tariff table, which also tells whether the commission is charged separately. If there is no company row, it takes the general service tariff and treats the commission as not separate. A missing tariff becomes zero. Continues to the commission calculation.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B4 (block 'RF-04: web orders pay half the tariff; payroll never pays commission', lines 79-92, phase pre)
    Calculates the commission: half the tariff, rounded to two decimals, for web orders, and the full tariff for other channels. For the payroll service ('NOMINA') the commission is set to zero. It then moves on to the balance check, with no error path.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B5 (block 'RF-06: virtual accounts cannot go below zero; other accounts may overdraw up to ', lines 94-106, phase pre)
    Works out the total to debit (order value, plus commission unless it is charged separately) and reads the account balance from the accounts table. Virtual accounts cannot go below zero, other accounts may overdraw by up to 100.00. If funds are insufficient it sets error 50004 and jumps to the error block; otherwise it goes on to the transaction.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B6 (block 'Statements 108-123', lines 108-123, phase transaction)
    Starts the transaction and calls sp_debito to debit the total from the account, returning the movement number to the caller. If the call returns an error, it rolls back, sets error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO' and jumps to the error block. Otherwise it continues to the commission step.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B7 (block 'RF-07: a separate commission is a second movement', lines 125-141, phase transaction)
    When the commission is charged separately and is greater than zero, it calls sp_debito a second time to debit the commission as its own movement. If that call fails, it rolls back the transaction, sets error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION' and jumps to the error block. Otherwise it continues to the order update.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B8 (block 'RF-08: the order is marked paid with the processing date and the commission char', lines 143-161, phase transaction)
    Updates the order in the payment orders table to status 'A' (paid), recording the processing date and the commission charged. If the update fails or affects no rows, it rolls back, sets error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN' and jumps to the error block. Otherwise it commits the transaction and continues to the final step.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B9 (block 'Statements 163-164', lines 163-164, phase post)
    Sets the output message to 'PAGO REALIZADO' and returns 0, signalling the payment completed successfully. It has no further connections.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B10 (block 'ERROR', lines 166-171, phase error)
    Common error handler reached from the failed checks and steps. It calls cobis..sp_cerror with the procedure name, the error number and the message, then returns the error code to the caller.
